title: 원문 확인 badge shown on procedures that actually render structured guidance
reproduce: Search 'F-4 재외동포' → chooser: 10/12 chips say 원문 확인; picking 체류지 변경 신고 / 등록사항 변경신고 / 외국인등록증 재발급 renders a FULLY_STRUCTURED common rule
root_cause: Chooser badge read the stored cell state codes[code].procedures[pid].s; the resolver's common-rule fallback (step 3b) answers those cells with a structured rule, so the badge understated what the page shows
affected: assets/js/status-guidance.js nextStep (procedure options); 172 of 2456 cells grid-wide
user_impact: Users told 'source only' for procedures that have organised guidance; badge meaning unreliable
fix: chipState(): badge derived from the resolver's own outcome for that pick; a follow-up question keeps the stored state
verification: audit_status_procedure_grid.mjs --check: understates 172→0 (fails on old resolver); restore-trust.spec.mjs chooser test 6/6 viewports

title: Contradictory '안내 가능' badge on an empty source-only page
reproduce: Search 'F-1-1 연장' → '안내 가능' badge next to '정리된 안내가 아직 없어요'
root_cause: Cell state SUPPORTED (parent rule exists) but no rule targets or covers the subcode; resolver returned the stored state on the source-only page
affected: status-guidance.js nextStep source-only branch; 16 cells (F-1 subcodes/scenarios, extension)
user_impact: A verified-looking badge on an empty answer — overstated certainty
fix: A SUPPORTED cell that no rule answers on this path is reported as SOURCE_ONLY for that path; chooser follows

title: Source-only answers were empty: nothing of the source shown
reproduce: F-4 → 사증발급 shows only '정리된 안내가 아직 없어요' and a button
